casual1.scene: A small brush with a smooth wooden handle; her companion is one small Eevee, on the dry mat beneath the porch roof. Rain beads along the railing.
casual1.outfit: A long oatmeal wool coat with tailored side cutouts and an open-back inset, worn open over a short cream underdress, with a loose knitted scarf; the open front reveals her legs.

why.scene: 브러싱 동료 한 마리와 비를 피한 마른 자리를 특정한다.
why.outfit: 롱 울 코트·니트 머플러를 유지하고 예약의 옆 트임과 열린 등을 구조로 반영한다.

era.en: inside the Pokémon world, as if she simply lives there

place.en: a covered porch on a rainy day, umbrellas resting by the door

act.en: gently brushing her Pokémon companion on a grooming mat

ofam.en: everyday clothes that suit the place and activity

item.en: a long wool coat and a knitted scarf

casual2.scene: The lake curves around pale granite shelves, with late-morning sunlight making clear ribbons beneath the water.
casual2.outfit: A high-waisted coral bikini with a supportive deeply dipped halter top and high-cut leg openings, fully lined and secure for swimming.

why.scene: 호수 수면 아래 빛과 암반을 구체화한다.
why.outfit: 예약의 클래식 비키니를 유지하고 하이컷과 깊은 목선을 반영한다.

ofam.en: modern swimwear, fully lined and secure during movement

casual3.scene: She has just finished a photo session; the booth bench has plum vinyl upholstery and a curtain with a chrome rail.
casual3.outfit: A black velvet halter-neck dress with a corset belt, detached lace sleeves and a short flared skirt, with a fitted lingerie lining fully concealed beneath the velvet.

why.scene: 휴식 직전 사진 촬영과 벤치 재질을 보충한다.
why.outfit: 벨벳 드레스와 코르셋 벨트·레이스 소매를 유지하며 홀터형 오픈 숄더로 예약의 목선을 반영한다.

era.en: the real world around the year her Pokémon first appeared

place.en: an arcade photo-sticker booth under bright ring lights
